description: This file contains step definitions for Cucumber BDD testing, specifically handling database validation scenarios in a test suite for the OrangeHRM application. It includes setup, actions, assertions, and cleanup for database state verification, utilizing utility classes for database operations.

classes.name: DatabaseValidationSteps
classes.description: Defines Cucumber step definitions for testing database operations such as insert, update, delete, and select, with assertions for validating database state in BDD scenarios for OrangeHRM.

methods.name: theDatabaseConnectionIsConfiguredForTheCurrentEnvironment
methods.description: Verifies the database connection for the current environment is properly configured and accessible.

methods.name: theTableExistsInTheDatabase
methods.description: Checks if a specified table exists in the database schema.

methods.name: aRecordExistsInTableWhereColumnEqualsValue
methods.description: Verifies that a specific record exists before test steps are executed.

methods.name: noRecordExistsInTableWhereColumnEqualsValue
methods.description: Ensures that no record matching criteria exists, cleaning up if necessary.

methods.name: iInsertARecordIntoTableWithColumnValue
methods.description: Inserts a single-column value record into a specified table.

methods.name: iInsertARecordIntoTableWithValues
methods.description: Inserts a record with multiple column-value pairs into a table.

methods.name: iUpdateTableSetColumnWhereCondition
methods.description: Updates a specific column in a table where a condition matches.

methods.name: iUpdateTableSetValuesWhereCondition
methods.description: Updates multiple columns in a table based on a condition.

methods.name: iDeleteFromTableWhereCondition
methods.description: Deletes records from a specified table matching a condition.

methods.name: iExecuteTheQuery
methods.description: Executes a custom SQL query and stores the result.

methods.name: iExecuteTheQueryWithParameter
methods.description: Executes a parameterized SQL query.

methods.name: theOperationShouldAffectNRows
methods.description: Asserts that a DML operation affected an expected number of rows.

methods.name: aRecordShouldExistInTableWhereColumnEquals
methods.description: Asserts that a specific record exists based on provided criteria.

methods.name: noRecordShouldExistInTableWhereColumnEquals
methods.description: Asserts that no such record exists.

methods.name: theValueOfColumnInTableShouldBe
methods.description: Checks that a specific column value matches expected for a particular row.

methods.name: theCountOfRecordsShouldBe
methods.description: Verifies the count of records matching a condition.

methods.name: theQueryResultShouldContainNRows
methods.description: Checks that the last executed query returned a specified number of rows.

methods.name: theQueryResultShouldNotBeEmpty
methods.description: Ensures the last query returned some results.

methods.name: theQueryResultShouldBeEmpty
methods.description: Ensures the last query returned no results.

methods.name: theDatabaseShouldBeAccessible
methods.description: Verifies connectivity and accessibility of the database.

methods.name: iCleanUpTheRecordInTableWhereColumnEquals
methods.description: Cleans up test data by deleting records matching criteria.
